description: Cover — checklist with seeded progress (6 of 55 earned; per-grade chips 0/1 platinum, 0/2 gold, 2/6 silver, 4/46 bronze), spoiler shield on so unearned story trophies render as Hidden trophy, kind filter chips (Platinum 1, Story 12, Missable 1, Collectibles 5, Activities 8, Side 7, Free-roam 18, Economy 4), the three view tabs (Checklist, Roadmap, Next up) and Export/Import buttons visible; the platinum card is pinned first with its own Platinum kind.

The Shootist guide panel open: Official description label, steps, the editable 17-of-42 counter, the guide headed 'Guide — in our own words' (its required-in-full claim now citing Push Square's 100% checklist breakdown), the new 'When it unlocks' and 'Pitfalls' lines (the pitfalls line likewise citing Push Square's breakdown), a saved personal note in the Your notes box, and its linked PowerPyx source named for this trophy.

Roadmap view, scrolled to the foot of the missable panel and the first stage card: the decision rule for Positive Mental Attitude (Potential missable; the panel above names its Chapter 1 'When it locks' window), the screened-and-cleared line for Actions Speak Louder (cumulative counter to 500 choices), the also-good-to-know notes (the Irredeemable line now naming PowerPyx), and Stage 1's full card — per-stage progress bar (4 of 12 earned from the seeded progress), rationale (the 60–80 hours attributed to PowerPyx's roadmap; the balcony spot stated as Positive Mental Attitude's, its 18-spot counter worked in stage 3 but the balcony itself done in stage 1), the Chapter 1 window warning for the balcony meditation inline — naming PowerPyx and GTABase, in the conditional framing (if the balcony spot counts toward the 18, missing it would force a fresh playthrough; published sources do not resolve whether it counts, so it is the safe default), and closing with the reassurance that A Long Road needs only 15 of the 18 spots so it is never at risk from this one — the effort estimate, and trophy chips with the four earned story trophies lit. The same view's top carries the 55/55 coverage line, and its foot the Platinum plan panel (composition 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze, 28 hidden, all single-player; phases in order; long poles named).

Next-up planner: from the seeded progress, the panel names the current stage (Stage 1 — Play the story, 4 of 12 earned, 8 to go) and how many trophies remain overall; below, the next unearned trophies in roadmap order with their stage tags, unlock lines and an Open guide jump for each.
